text:
Sam: FYI customer (Acme) reports intermittent result-join confusion when we fan out to multiple tools in one request. Two tools called in parallel: search + summarize. Sometimes summarize result shows search output and vice versa. Correlation: req_92fa7c. Repro steps below.

Maria: Ugh. Can you paste the failing request body and any logs? Which SDK/version?

Sam: SDK v1.3.2. Minimal repro (sanitized):
```json
{
  "request_id": "req_92fa7c",
  "model": "gpt-redwood-13b",
  "tools": [
    { "name": "search", "args": { "query": "who invented widget" } },
    { "name": "summarize", "args": { "content": "<search_result_text>" } }
  ],
  "tool_options": { "parallel": true }
}
```
When I replayed 10x, 3 runs returned swapped tool_result associations. In one case we also saw a schema validation error from the summarize tool: `schema mismatch: expected object for 'content', got string` even though the body sent an object (seen only when both tools are parallel).

Kevin: Can you share the raw headers and the tool_result entries from the runtime log? Need X-Request-ID / correlation-id and any tool_result_id pairs. This sounds like a correlation header being dropped or two futures resolving on the same callback slot.

Sam: Pasted small excerpt from runtime log (sanitized):
```
[2026-03-16T14:02:11.123Z] req=req_92fa7c -> fanout: search (call_id=call_aa, corr=cid_1)
[2026-03-16T14:02:11.125Z] req=req_92fa7c -> fanout: summarize (call_id=call_bb, corr=cid_2)
[2026-03-16T14:02:11.310Z] tool_result: call_bb -> tr_007, payload_size=14kb
[2026-03-16T14:02:11.311Z] tool_result: call_aa -> tr_006, payload_size=1.2kb
[2026-03-16T14:02:11.312Z] merge_results: req=req_92fa7c ordering=[tr_007,tr_006] -> attach to tools [search,summarize]
```
Notice the ordering and final attach looks like it was based on arrival order instead of call_id. In some runs the `content` field for summarize arrived as raw string (causing the schema error) even though upstream produces object.

Ashley: This matches a hypothesis we discussed earlier about the result-join path using arrival order rather than stable call_id mapping for parallel fans. If the join uses an index-based merge that assumes deterministic ordering, races will swap pairs.

Maria: Customer impact? Frequency? Is there any billing consequence?

Sam: Impacted 5 of their 1200 requests in the last hour (high severity for them because we returned incorrect summaries). No billing duplication but incorrect outputs. They want a hotfix or mitigation.

Kevin: Temporary mitigations: 1) set `tool_options.parallel=false` (force sequential) 2) include explicit `call_id` in tool args and return to us so we can map server-side 3) enable stricter schema validation at the merge boundary so malformed payloads fail loudly instead of mapping to wrong tool.

ReproBot: Automated repro run started: run_id=run_20260316_01. Outcome: 10 replays -> 3/10 observed swapped join. Attached sample diff log: `merge_results` shows ordering based on arrival timestamp.

Ashley: I'll capture the 14:00-14:10 UTC trace and increase correlation logging for fanout merges. Kevin - can you open an INF ticket and include the trace + these logs? Mark P0 for accuracy.

Kevin: Opening INF-4921 now. Assign to eng-runtime. I'll add the excerpt and a minimal failing test. Also adding a tolerance check in merge code to assert call_id mapping; if mismatch then log with `err=join_mismatch` and fail-safe to sequential map.

Maria: I'll reply to the customer with mitigations and ask them to test `parallel=false` while we work the fix. Please add a short repro snippet for them.

Sam: Adding suggested snippet for customer: set `tool_options.parallel=false` OR include `call_id` per tool (unique) and set header `X-Client-Corr: <req>` so we can map. Example: `tools[0].call_id = "call_search_1"`

Kevin: Patch plan: (1) quick guard to prefer call_id mapping if present (hotfix), (2) add assert + telemetry for 48h, (3) root-cause fix to ensure merge uses map keyed by call_id not arrival index. Will ship canary to Dedicated and Hosted tonight.

Ashley: I'll coordinate rollout window and postmortem if we see >0.1% failures after fix.

Sam: Thanks all. I uploaded full sanitized request+response bundle to the ticket (INF-4921). Tagging @Kevin for follow-up. :eyes:

Kevin: Got it. Following up in the ticket.

ReproBot: Automated repro run complete: run_id=run_20260316_01 result=flaky_count=3/10. Logs -> https://internal.redwood/repro/run_20260316_01

Maria: Noted. I'll coordinate customer testing.

Ashley: I'll keep an eye on the traces and post a status update in 30 minutes.
